integration_ownership.obligation: Prove the exact generalized-inverse sublevel identity needed for implemented inversion from actual CDF-law correspondence; the quantile coupling example remains contextual.

**Disposition:** extend-existing substantial algorithm/error guarantee. `ex-quantile-coupling-on-the-real-line` already proves generalized inverse Q(U) has the target law; `lem-randomized-probability-integral-transform` treats the reverse randomized CDF transform. Do not redefine those statistical transformations as a new method. The example is contextual rather than a legal logical supplier; consume `thm-probability-law-and-distribution-function-correspondence` and promote only the needed generalized-inverse sublevel identity to a typed prerequisite with proof/source attribution, avoiding a duplicate broad quantile-coupling theorem. The new guarantee is actual bit/stream implementation and finite-distribution error plus Box-Muller sampling, absent from inspected canonical methods.

**Randomness model:** independent ideal fair bits B_j on an explicitly constructed countable product probability space; U=sum B_j 2^-j has uniform law by dyadic cylinder intervals and continuity of measure. Disjoint bit blocks/streams preserve independence. A b-bit K uniform on {0,...,2^b-1} gives U_b=(K+1/2)2^-b, coupling |U-U_b|<=2^(-b-1), hence W1 at most that and Kolmogorov discrepancy at most 2^-b. Finite-support versus continuous law has total variation distance1, so no TV-small assertion. Independence of finite outputs requires disjoint independent bit blocks; recycling bits changes dependence.

**Practical finite generators:** define an actual full-period LCG modulo 2^w with odd increment and multiplier a congruent1 mod4, w>=2; prove full period by induction modulo powers of2 using affine iterate arithmetic, and state finite state/period bound for every deterministic generator. With random uniform initial state each single state is uniform, but adjacent states satisfy the recurrence and are not independent. Give a counter-based stream interface as a deterministic keyed permutation of finite counters; a random permutation/key model or computational pseudorandomness assumption must be explicit, never an IID theorem. No cryptographic-quality claim or empirical-test proof of independence. Non-overlapping blocks avoid exact reuse only within certified period; do not imply probabilistic independence.

**Variates:** inverse CDF already canonical; add implemented bracketed inverse with certified |F(xhat)-u|<=epsilon on a monotone continuous CDF, finite-bit U discrepancy adds to Kolmogorov error (plus any actual CDF approximation error). Spatial error requires density f>=m>0 on the inversion bracket, and tails handled separately. Discrete CDF binary search gives exact categorical law under ideal U, finite-bit count discrepancy bounded per threshold; Bernoulli rational sampling via unbiased integer rejection has geometric expected bit/block cost and budget failure; finite budget discarded separately.

Box-Muller uses independent ideal U1,U2 in (0,1), Z1=sqrt(-2 log U1)cos(2pi U2), Z2=sqrt(-2 log U1)sin(2pi U2). Prove independent standard-normal density by polar change of variables and product density normalization; same-pair polar Jacobian/measure change prerequisite must be proved if not published. Finite bits imply bounded normal tails and discrete output, never exact Gaussian; couple midpoint U_b to U, restrict U1>=delta and guard angular/endpoint arithmetic, derivative bounds give explicit Wasserstein/bounded-Lipschitz output error on that event, while discarded event probability <=delta+2^-b. Tail expectations use proved Gaussian/Rayleigh moments and Cauchy-Schwarz; elementary log/sqrt/trig evaluation errors supplied by precision owner add through those derivative bounds. No Ziggurat implementation required if not fully specified/proved; rejection algorithm may be a later optional genuinely new optimization only with envelope/area proof. Gaussian samples in SDE algorithms are ideal-law or approximate-law with this additional coupling error propagated; no invisible exact-normal finite-bit oracle.

**Same-frontier prerequisites:** product independent-bit construction (reuse existing countable product theorem if available, otherwise own cylinder extension), dyadic uniform law, LCG modular induction, stopping/rejection cost, finite-CDF inverse residual, polar transform identity, truncated-transform coupling and arithmetic error propagation. Root must map any newly located canonical supplier instead of creating duplicate items. **Examples:** low-bit LCG correlation/lattice, normal tail truncation, zero endpoint log failure, inverse CDF near vanishing density. **Cost:** random bits, rejection count, integer arithmetic, precision and transform calls; bit cost distinct from real-RAM sampling oracle cost. **Sources, unread candidates:** Devroye, Non-Uniform Random Variate Generation, author's full-book portal https://luc.devroye.org/rnbookindex.html ; L'Ecuyer RNG publications https://www.iro.umontreal.ca/~lecuyer/myftp/papers.html ; Box/Muller, Ann Math Stat 29 (1958), https://doi.org/10.1214/aoms/1177706645 .
